build_note: Yun Tal Wildarrows first for AS + AD — Season 16 Yun Tal gives 0% crit so build RFC second to reach 25% crit, then Collector (50% total) before IE (75% crit, IE passive fully active). Switch to rockets after first reset kill — rockets hit multiple targets and chain resets. Never stop shooting.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — or replace BT slot if already ahead
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs heavy burst/dive — delays IE but safer
kit_notes: Rockets in ARAM hit every grouped enemy every auto. Crit threshold for IE: RFC(25%) + Collector(25%) = 50% before IE → 75% total. Reset passive (Jinx Get Excited) activates on any kill/assist — use aggression resets freely. W flame chompers for zoning packs. E mine field at health pack approaches.
aram_specific: ARAM is Jinx's best game mode. Grouped enemies + infinite ammo + reset passive = snowball engine. Use rockets the moment you get a reset. Super Mega Death Rocket at 70%+ HP enemies — don't use as execute, the damage scales with missing HP of the FIRST target hit.
